messages:
alex: Quick sync — BankCorp wants a 4-week trial for contextual matching/search. Need to lock success criteria (latency/cost/quality), security asks, and an initial burn estimate. Who can lead the technical handoff?

maya: I can take the SE handoff next Wed. For criteria, propose: p95 latency <= 150ms (hosted), avg cost per 1k tokens <$1.25 for inference, and relevance eval > 0.82 MAP on their 2k prompt set.

sam: Sounds reasonable. A couple of notes: BankCorp requires KMS + VPC option for any customer data. Also legal needs DPA + data retention details before we spin up Dedicated capacity.

jordan: On the eval: we should define the prompt suite and acceptance script. Suggest sample thresholds: precision@10 >= 0.7 and MRR >= 0.6. We can run a baseline on redwood:open-compat-7B and a quantized variant.

alex: Good. Can we write that as a concrete acceptance checklist so Sales can share with the customer? Also they asked about pricing tiers — hosted vs Dedicated monthly commit.

maya: Draft checklist (short):
- Functional: relevance MAP >= 0.82 on provided eval set; precision@10 >= 0.7; MRR >= 0.6.
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms (initial), p95 <= 120ms target after tuning.
- Cost: estimated inference cost <= $1.25 / 1k tokens (hosted) or equivalent committed capacity pricing.
- Security: KMS + VPC, SOC2, DPA signed, optional on-prem package if required.
- Ops: canary rollout + automatic fallback to smaller model for burst periods.

sam: I like it. Add a burn gate: 1M tokens total budget for the trial unless they agree to scale. That helps finance estimate billing.

jordan: For the eval harness, copy/paste of sample script we run internally:
```
# eval snippet (pseudo)
for prompt in eval_set:
  candidate = call_model(prompt)
  score = relevance(candidate, ground_truth)
  record(score)
# compute MAP, MRR, precision@10
```
We'll share the harness and ask them to provide labels or allow us to annotate a 2k-sample subset.

alex: BankCorp's security contact pinged: they want answers to the questionnaire about key management, logs, and data deletion SLA. @security-bot can you attach the standard answers and ETA for DPA draft?

security-bot: Automated: Uploaded: /playbooks/security-templates/KMS-VPC-answers.md. DPA draft ETA: 3 business days. Contact: legal@redwood.com.

maya: Timeline proposal: Week 0 (legal + security signoffs), Week 1 (seed data + eval run), Week 2 (tuning + latency/cost optimizations), Week 3 (customer acceptance run), Week 4 (final acceptance + wrap).

sam: Operational blockers: If they require on-prem for keys, we need infra lead sign-off (2-3 day setup). Also confirm watermarking/PII handling in prompts — legal asked for sanitization plan.

alex: Action items:
- maya: lead SE handoff call (Wed 10am PT) and share evaluation harness.
- jordan: produce a first-pass acceptance checklist doc and quick cost/burn estimate.
- sam: reply to security questionnaire with KMS/VPC notes and flag any on-prem infra requests.
- legal: draft DPA (security-bot says 3 days).

maya: I'll post the harness + a short how-to for running locally in the thread after the call.

jordan: I'll attach the acceptance checklist and a sample cost calc: 1M tokens * $0.00125/token = $1,250 expected inference spend (hosted) before optimizations. We'll show Dedicated commit equivalence options in the doc.

alex: Great — if we hit the acceptance thresholds we can propose a Dedicated pilot pricing on week 5. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: One more: customer asked about model explainability for top-3 results. We should add a short note on how we surface token-level attributions or signal ranking.

maya: noted — will add a section in the checklist for "explainability / result provenance" with examples to share.

alex: Closing — I'll schedule the handoff and share calendar invite. If anything urgent, DM me.
